title: Issue #1 — 3-char cafeteria identity bleed probe (template roles)
intent: Long-session stress with adjacent template roles; priming/probe user lines come from --user-trigger-schedule. Owner of role instigator = Harley card; non-owner N = Magpie (new_arrival slot); Ivy = instigator_accomplice.
opening_description: Arkham cafeteria at shift change: plastic trays, weak coffee, a guard's radio murmuring at the edge of hearing. Harley is wound tight; Ivy has claimed a table like territory; Magpie watches both, ready to side-step or steal focus. CAST roles: one instigator, one instigator accomplice, one new arrival—authority and blame are easy to confuse when the room is watching.
trigger_text: A tray clatters—too loud. Harley's eyes jump to Ivy's hands. Magpie mutters, 'Nobody's eating until someone says what this is really about.'

seed_issue.description: Public cafeteria tension; instigator, instigator accomplice, and new-arrival slots create adjacent-authority confusion for attribution probes.
